name: Market Informant
background: A street-level informant who sells information. He knows the inner circle movements and can be bought.

genericReactions.physical: Is it worth anything? If not, I'm not interested.
genericReactions.testimonial: Words are cheap. Information has a price.
genericReactions.digital: A name on a list? That could be valuable. What's your offer?
genericReactions.environmental: I know every alley in this city. That knowledge costs silver.
genericReactions.analytical: Thirty pieces of silver. That's a number I understand.
genericReactions.prophecy: I don't trade in prophecies. Only in facts and coin.
